com.invoiceparserpro/capability.description: Allocate a whole invoice or one selected printed line to a load number. Keeps other allocations and the invoice amounts unchanged. Review and confirm the exact change first. The preview expires after five minutes. Preview only; nothing is applied until you confirm.
examples: Preview allocating the whole invoice we selected to the load number we chose. Show existing allocations and wait for my confirmation.
Preview assigning only the printed-line index we identified to the selected load number, keeping other allocations. Wait for my confirmation.
